Main phase lifecycle diagnostic controller correction — 2026-10-13

Model lifetime root v2 passed READY, fresh1024 prefill and checked map/fill/publish to912, then legitimately emitted EOS248046 with DONE1 ... stop. Engine serve emits EOS and stops even if max_new2 is the requested cap. Source generate.cpp10233 onward is authoritative; exact cap2 is not a generation requirement. V2 controller incorrectly asserted two length outputs before QUIT and direct_owner sent owned SIGTERM. The resulting exit-15/observation incomplete/cleanup action remain an original failed lifecycle result. No phase normal-QUIT qualification and no benchmark sample is claimed. Fresh fault entries0/devcoredump absent; all owned processes reaped/sessionempty.

V3 accepts1..max_new outputs with stop or length, requires exact max_new only for length, equal observed T lines and DONE count, full prompt read and no reused/drafts. It records structural/result mismatches then performs checked normal QUIT before judging; it does not change engine requests or computation. Regex word boundaries are corrected and sanity checked to include reset queued as well as engine reset. Original v2 controller/hash/receipt stays unchanged. A fresh output/process and pre/post identity/health/fault gates still apply. Small GENs remain lifetime diagnostics only, never speed evidence; unmodified upstream bench.sh owns performance.
